dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: About the tale of the giant sea serpent...

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: #Yes, the giant sea serpent in {NICKNAME}'s story sounds amazing. But there's nothing more to it now that it's already been taken down.

dialogues.speaker: Kavus
dialogues.text: I wonder if there are other giant sea serpents... If so, that'll be the moment when Captain Kavus makes his entrance!
